statements.t: “With our strong results and continued demand for unforgettable experiences in iconic destinations, we are on track to deliver full year growth in line with our prior guidance range, and we remain well positioned to advance our growth pipeline and create long-term shareholder value.”

In addition to the commentary above, further information regarding Pursuit's financial results, trends, and outlook is available in a supplemental earnings presentation, which can be accessed on the "Investors" section of the company's website, and in the financial tables accompanying this press release.
• Total debt was $134.2 million and Pursuit’s net leverage ratio was 0.6x at September 30, 2026, below the company’s target range of 2.0x to 3.5x.

“Based on continued demand for our authentic experiences and strong results year-to-date, we are reaffirming our full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA midpoint expectation of $133 million and narrowing our guidance range to $130 million to $136 million, from $128 million to $138 million, reinforcing our confidence in our ability to deliver,” said Barry.

*Pursuit has not quantitatively reconciled its guidance for Adjusted EBITDA to the company’s most comparable GAAP financial measure because certain reconciling items that impact this metric, including provision for income taxes, interest expense, restructuring or impairment charges, transaction-related costs, and start-up costs have not occurred, are out of the company’s control, or cannot be reasonably predicted.

These projects are part of the company’s Vision 2030 strategy to deploy more than $300 million into high-returning organic growth investments in well-instrumented existing businesses that enhance the guest experience.

A live audio webcast of the call will be available in listen-only mode through the "Events & Presentations" section of Pursuit’s investor website, where the company will also post its earnings press release and a supplemental earnings presentation prior to the call.
